text: ポケモンの　ひんし　じょうたいは　たたかう　げんきが　ない　だけで　いあいぎり　などの　わざは　いつもの　ように　つかえる！

structure.jp: ポケモンの　ひんし　じょうたいは
たたかう　げんきが　ない　だけで
structure.en: is just having no energy to battle, and

structure.jp: いあいぎり　などの　わざは
いつもの　ように　つかえる！

patterns.name: 〜だけで
patterns.explanation: だけ means 'only', and で joins it to what follows, giving 'it is only that, and nothing more'. げんきが ない だけで = 'it just has no energy, that's all, and'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.explanation: A verb placed right before a thing describes it. たたかう げんき = 'the energy to battle'.

patterns.name: 〜のように
patterns.explanation: A thing plus の ように means 'in the same way as' that thing. いつもの ように = 'the same as always'.
